t: T-Rex Waterproof & Repair Tape offers a robust solution for challenging repairs on wet, rough, or difficult surfaces. This versatile black tape is ideal for plumbing, automotive, and general outdoor repairs, providing a reliable fix for trade professionals. Engineered with Flex-to-Fit Technology, it features a highly conformable film and a solventless UV acrylic adhesive, allowing maximum stretch and fitting into tight spaces. Repositionable yet strong, it offers easy application and extreme weather performance. Adhering effectively to various materials, including concrete, metal, and plastic, it instantly seals out water, air, and moisture. Odourless and solvent-free, this tape ensures fast and effective repairs. Tape is not designed to withhold water pressure.
